headline: Deadlock Breaks as Warden Counterstrikes Sweep Godcrofts and Mooring County
war_summary: The temporary strategic freeze broke decisively over the past three hours as counterattacks rolled across several active theatres. Godcrofts erupted into violent upheaval, recording twelve base transition events within two hours as Warden forces mounted a sweeping maritime counterstroke, raising their tally to six strategic bases against three Colonial holdings. In Mooring County, Warden arms erased the Colonial salient at The Wind Hills, restoring complete twelve-base control over the sector. Contested Stonecradle remains a furious meatgrinder, absorbing over a thousand casualties in two hours while base exchanges elevated Warden holdings to five against four Colonial bastions. To the west, Fishermans Row remains unsettled with two fresh base incidents leaving one site abandoned in no-man's-land. Heavy frontline attrition continues unabated elsewhere; both Callahan's Passage and Weathered Expanse endure blistering casualty rates that sharply accelerated over the latest hour despite lines holding firm. In contrast, previously turbulent sectors such as Linn of Mercy and Dead Lands have cooled into hushed lulls, shifting the war's sharpest pressures to the disputed northern and island fronts.
